mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account(account_no, owner_name, brokerage_id) VALUES(#{accountNo}, #{ownerName}, #{brokerageId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id, a.account_no, a.owner_name, al.member_id, a.brokerage_id, b.brokerage_name, a.balance, a.return_rate, a.profit_amount, a.holding_stock_quantity, a.create_at, al.linked_at FROM account a JOIN brokerage b ON a.brokerage_id = b.brokerage_id JOIN account_link al ON al.account_id = a.account_id WHERE al.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_no, a.owner_name, al.member_id, a.brokerage_id, b.brokerage_name, a.balance, a.return_rate, a.profit_amount, a.holding_stock_quantity, a.create_at, al.linked_at FROM account a JOIN brokerage b ON a.brokerage_id = b.brokerage_id LEFT JOIN account_link al ON al.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_no, a.owner_name, al.member_id, a.brokerage_id, b.brokerage_name, a.balance, a.return_rate, a.profit_amount, a.holding_stock_quantity, a.create_at, al.linked_at FROM account a JOIN brokerage b ON a.brokerage_id = b.brokerage_id LEFT JOIN account_link al ON al.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.brokerage_id = #{brokerageId} AND a.account_no = #{accountNo}

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_no, a.owner_name, al.member_id, a.brokerage_id, b.brokerage_name, a.balance, a.return_rate, a.profit_amount, a.holding_stock_quantity, a.create_at, al.linked_at FROM account a JOIN brokerage b ON a.brokerage_id = b.brokerage_id LEFT JOIN account_link al ON al.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.brokerage_id = #{brokerageId} AND al.link_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.account_id
